description: This file defines the CKEditor class for embedding a rich text editor into PHP web pages. It includes methods for creating, replacing, and configuring CKEditor instances, handling events, and generating the necessary JavaScript integration code.

classes.name: CKEditor
classes.description: A PHP class to generate CKEditor instances, set configurations, handle events, and embed the editor within web pages.

methods.name: editor
methods.description: Creates a CKEditor instance associated with a textarea element, with optional initial value, configuration, and event handlers.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces an existing textarea element with a CKEditor instance, based on element ID or name, with optional configuration and event handlers.

methods.name: replaceAll
methods.description: Replaces all textarea elements in the document, optionally filtered by a specific class name, with CKEditor instances.

methods.name: addEventHandler
methods.description: Adds a JavaScript event handler to the CKEditor instance.

methods.name: clearEventHandlers
methods.description: Removes registered event handlers for the CKEditor instance.

methods.name: addGlobalEventHandler
methods.description: Adds a global JavaScript event listener for CKEditor events.

methods.name: clearGlobalEventHandlers
methods.description: Removes global event handlers for CKEditor events.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Generates and returns the necessary JavaScript code to initialize CKEditor, including loading scripts and setting base path.

methods.name: ckeditorPath
methods.description: Determines the URL path to the CKEditor JavaScript files, based on configured base path or server environment.

methods.name: jsEncode
methods.description: Encodes PHP values into JSON format, supporting nested arrays and special scalar handling for integration with JavaScript.

methods.name: script
methods.description: Wraps JavaScript code into an HTML <script> block for embedding in the page.

methods.name: configSettings
methods.description: Merges global and instance-specific configurations and event handlers into a single configuration array for CKEditor.

methods.name: returnGlobalEvents
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code to register global CKEditor event listeners.
